body:
Path: none | 清单区 i18n:报表/数据集面板 | 四个 repeater 行属性标签在三个语言里都与 en 源逐字节相同(12 叶)

## What was measured

An isolated at-tier contract review of PR #19345 (card #17508, comment 5750013153, head `74dcce59635a0b7d0f1f5b487a0e8dc0bd806da1`) mechanically checked all 336 hand-authored translation leaves that PR ships and found **0 en-echoes** among them. In the same pass it measured a **pre-existing** echo on the neighbouring panels, outside that card's scope:

Four repeater row-property labels are **byte-identical to their `en` source in all three translated locales** — `zh-CN`, `ja-JP` and `es-ES` — which is 12 leaves:

- `report.fields.values`
- `report.fields.rows`
- `report.fields.dataset`
- `dataset.fields.measures`

⛔ These are **not** regressions from #19345 and ⛔ not leaves it authored. They were already in the catalogs, and the reviewer names them precisely because the card's own pin proves the surrounding population is clean — which is what makes these visible as debt rather than as noise.

## Why it is a card and not a rider

The reviewer's own words: 「a card, not a rider」. The #17508 round was ruled as one coherent landing over a defined carrier set, and widening it to fix neighbouring panels would be the scope creep that ruling's shape refuses. ⇒ recorded here so the debt survives #17508's close.

⚠️ **An echo is not automatically a defect.** Some strings legitimately do not translate, and the same review measured two declared departures on the #19345 side that turned out true — `Dataset` is an en-echo at base in all three locales, and the round translated it deliberately. ⇒ whoever takes this card decides **per leaf** whether the echo is the right rendering or an unauthored fallback, and records the reason either way. ⛔ Do not mass-translate the twelve.

## The pin that would notice

`packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/repeater-row-properties.test.ts` (landed by #19345) carries the `dashboard-header-children.test.ts` last test — a translated leaf is never a copy of its `en` source — and derives its population from the forms. ⚠️ These four labels sit on panels **outside** that pin's population today; extending it is one of the options this card should weigh, since a reason recorded in prose and a reason recorded in a ledger row are not worth the same.
